notes.content:
An update has been released for Scuffy Game.

[h2]Patch Notes and Changes[/h2]
Added the ability to adjust the max players when you are about to host a server.
[list][*] Added the ability to make servers private only.
[*] Added the ability to make servers lan only.
[*] Adjusted the event timer to now be accurate for when the live event takes place.

[h2]M.D.L.M: Scuffy Game's Final In-Game Live Event[/h2]

Jump into [b]M.D.L.M[/b] - Scuffy Game's final live event — on [b]Sunday, April 13, 2025, at 1 AM, and will repeat every hour in case you miss a few showings![/b] This event marks the end of Scuffy Game's 3rd year anniversary update, and a story overwrite so that it's no longer connected to The Multiverse Trilogy, and Alternate Universe.

[h2]How to join the event[/h2]
M.D.L.M is a Scuffy Game live event starting on Sunday, April 13, 2025, at 1 AM, and will repeat every hour in case you miss a few showings! The event playlist will be available 30 minutes prior to the event starting in the main menu of the game. No update to the game is needed.

Play with random people, or friends and watch the event unfold. M.D.L.M event max player count will be at 20 players.

[h2]The Aftermath When "M.D.L.M" Takes Place[/h2]
On April 14, we will release a small patch to make the event available to play, but will only be solo mode. The original event from May 2022 (The Finale) will also be available for those who weren't around to attend the event.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
With the Scuffy Game's final live event in sight, it's time to prepare for a new end, and a new beginning.

notes.title: In-Game Live Event Delayed!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It pains me to say that the in-game live event that is schedule for tomorrow (April 5th) has been delayed once again, and will now take place on April 13th. Will still have the same time frame as mentioned in our other post.

[h2]What happened?[/h2]
There are a few reasons as to why we had to make the difficult decision to push the event further away.

[list][*] We recently started running into a lot of technical issues, and because of it, we aren't able to push out a hotfix to the game to push the timer to the day the event will take place. The timer will hit zero, but it won't do anything at this time.
[*] Due to recent events and personal reasons that has happened with a few of our team members, we will be taking a few days off to respect their privacy, and we also don't overwhelm them with it.[/list]

[h2]Are the rest of the plans for the event still happening?[/h2]
Yes, everything planned before, during, and after the event will still happen despite the event getting pushed back. More details below.

[h2]How to join the event after the delay[/h2]
M.D.L.M will now take place on Sunday, April 13, 2025, at 1 AM, and will repeat every hour in case you miss a few showings! The event playlist will be available 30 minutes prior to the event starting in the main menu of the game. No update to the game is needed after our final major update that is still planned.

Play with random people, or friends and watch the event unfold. M.D.L.M event max player count will be at 20 players.

[h2]The Aftermath When "M.D.L.M" Takes Place[/h2]
On April 14th, we will release a small patch to make the event available to play, but will only be solo mode. The original event from May 2022 (The Finale) will also be available for those who weren't around to attend the event.

We're sorry for another delay on the event, but appreciate your support and patience.

notes.title: Scuffy Game 3 Year Anniversary Update! (v4.0)
notes.content:
We launched Scuffy Game 3 years ago. As a celebration, we went back and updated the game to be more polished, and have more content than how we left it back in October 2023. The game hasn't received as much attention in recent years, so we thought this milestone was a great opportunity to spruce up the player experience and add some fun new ways to play the game. Just like our other game "My Dad Left Me", this update wouldn't have been possible without the help of Benjer Software (formally GhosStudios).

[b]WARNING: This game has been upgraded to a newer version of Unreal Engine 5, and there might be a few bugs that we have missed when porting this game to a new engine version. If that's the case, let us know by starting a discussion here on the Steam page, or on our Discord server.[/b]

[h3]The same game you played in 2022 - restored, and repurposed[/h3]

We may or may not have been leaving [url=https://phoenixlimitsecrets.com/]secrets in a webpage to showcase any teasers for what's to come[/url]. This may or may not also include teasers for upcoming projects (or live events :3).

[h3]Also including lots of new content![/h3]

The 3rd Anniversary Update includes new maps and modes as well as repurposed maps from an old build of Alternate Universe that somewhat lead to the creation of Scuffy Game (besides Crab Game). We've also restored the old Waiting Room as a night time area to fit in with the nostalgia (This will be changed back to day time soon). This also includes the Main Menu part of the game because now has the new, and old version.

[h3]And an upcoming live event one (1!) month after[/h3]

As previously mentioned above... sort of, we do plan to premiere one final live event around March of this year as a thank you for the great memories, and a farewell to this game. Yes, we have said in the past that those updates would be the last one's, but seeing how the game's state was prior to this update seemed... off. Post live event, we do plan on still supporting the game with seasonal content (e.g, summer update, and winter update) going forward.

Once again, thank you <3

[h1]Bug Fixes and Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list][*] Added a new main menu music.
[*] Re-added the old main menu screen, along side with the new one.
[*] Added new UI sound effects.
[*] Added the ability to throw axe as long as you have ammo.
[*] [b]FINALLY[/b] added the ability to push people.
[*] [b]FINALLY[/b] added player name tags.
[*] Added new buttons for the host to pick in the main lobby.
[*] Added new levels/game modes to the game.
[*] Added new achievements.[/list]

[h2]Nostalgia[/h2]
[list][*] Brought back the old Waiting Room as a night time version.
[*] Brought back old tape system with new dialogue.[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list][*] Reduced the max player count per server from 40 to 20.
[*] Fixed an issue where textures wouldn't render in most maps.
[*] Fixed an issue where all animations stopped working [b](Yes, we did say previously that we "intended" to remove the animations, but it was mainly due to an engine issue)[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes games won't end when all players are dead.
[*] Adjusted the Steam Networking system to be more seamless when traveling to different maps.
[*] Changed a few achievements to have new one's.
[*] Changed how the Kraken Boss worked, so now you must defeat the Kraken to win.
[*] Added Nanite and Lumen in the game (can be turned off in the settings menu)
[*] Fixed an issue where the music would restart when fully turning down the music volume.
[*] Adjusted "your mum's basement" map/mode.
[*] Added the ability to freely spectate in free cam mode. Only occurs after death.
[*] Added new OST (Original Soundtrack) to replace the old one's that weren't ours.
[*] Other improvements and fixes.[/list]

[h2]Notes[/h2]
We now have movie files in the game. If you REALLY want to, change the movie file to something your heart desires (make sure you name the mp4 file the same way it is in the original file). Have fun :3
